# A merged-away vanId is refused forever, with its own message

**Claim.** A vanId that has been merged away is refused on either side of any later merge with a different message from the one an id that never existed gets. Since GET /people/{vanId} answers 404 for both, this endpoint is the only way to tell them apart.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1mergeInto/put`

## Observed exchange

_Three records: two to merge now, one to attempt a second merge against later._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Ivy",
  "lastName": "Calloway-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Ivy",
  "lastName": "Calloway-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000002
{
  "vanId": 100000002,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Omar",
  "lastName": "Haddad-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000003
{
  "vanId": 100000003,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Merge the secondary away. Its vanId now 404s on GET /people/{vanId}._

```http
(setup) PUT /people/100000002/mergeInto

{
  "vanId": 100000001
}

→ 200
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001
}
```

_Reuse that merged-away id in a fresh merge. It is remembered, permanently._

```http
PUT /people/100000002/mergeInto

{
  "vanId": 100000003
}

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "One or more of these contacts has already been merged."
    }
  ]
}
```

_An id that never existed is refused too, but with different text. That difference is the only way to tell the two apart — GET /people/{vanId} answers 404 for both._

```http
PUT /people/2147483646/mergeInto

{
  "vanId": 100000003
}

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "You must have access to both contacts to merge them."
    }
  ]
}
```
